expected_rule: Access must be approved when required and effective on or after the employee start date.
reason: Grant effective date was moved before the employee start date.

expected_rule: An asset may have at most one active assignment at a time.
reason: The same asset has two simultaneously active employee assignments.

expected_rule: Terminated employees must not have active access grants.
reason: An active access grant was retained for a terminated employee.

expected_rule: The task prerequisite graph must be acyclic.
reason: A reverse dependency was added, creating a two-task cycle.

expected_rule: Recovered assets must not retain an active assignment.
reason: A recovered asset is still marked as assigned.
